acceptance_cases.positive: Fresh original-input, static-entry, source and explicit trust-policy reconstruction succeeds before any native probe or original launch.
acceptance_cases.reject_or_incomplete: Cached verdict, altered signed bytes, rehashed substitution, missing source member, or example-runtime relabelling.

acceptance_cases.positive: Only the declared argv, exact minimal view, two filters and fixed worker phase are selected.
acceptance_cases.reject_or_incomplete: Unreviewed flags, --try variants, --as-pid-1, external namespace FDs, Python/runtime files or caller-selected executable.

acceptance_cases.positive: Fresh same-host qualification establishes exact required namespaces, openat2, cross-namespace tracing/proc reads and owned cleanup, including explicitly selected negative checks.
acceptance_cases.reject_or_incomplete: Unexpected denial or unsupported return on an operation required to succeed; incomplete qualifier, different observer/kernel/environment, or automatic privileged/unconfined fallback. Expected extra-userns denial is not such a failure.

acceptance_cases.positive: L creates R once and R creates T once with the two source-bound clone contracts and complete role identities.
acceptance_cases.reject_or_incomplete: Extra or missing task, wrong parent, clone flags, syscall ABI, role/order, reused PID or ignored task-creation event.

acceptance_cases.positive: The two declared exec transitions occur; T is stopped at the exact static ELF entry after successful exec and before user instructions.
acceptance_cases.reject_or_incomplete: Wrong executable, signal mistaken for exec event, failed exec, additional exec, altered RIP, or any terminal T restart.

acceptance_cases.positive: Final R/T namespace handles, maps and per-role observations match the declared new containment relations.
acceptance_cases.reject_or_incomplete: Early namespace report only, inode inequality alone, missing final maps, alias/reuse, or host namespace substituted.

acceptance_cases.positive: Pinned T root, complete path/mount roster, modes and copied entry bytes match the private read-only minimal view.
acceptance_cases.reject_or_incomplete: Writable effective mount, unexpected path/mount, missing root walk, symlink escape, host directory, proc/dev, or assuming memfd inode equals installed executable.

acceptance_cases.positive: Each of R and T has its own exact selected-program syscall-entry bytes, successful return and task-bound installation evidence.
acceptance_cases.reject_or_incomplete: Seccomp=2 alone, wrong BPF bytes, one role missing, nonzero return, or treating R installation as inherited by already-forked T.

acceptance_cases.positive: T has exact stdio descriptors, selected environment including PWD, zero selected capability fields and NNP=1.
acceptance_cases.reject_or_incomplete: Extra/unknown FD, missing observation, unexpected capability/environment, or claiming the unexecuted shim performed checks/close_range/limits.

acceptance_cases.positive: The owned observer records complete ordered raw events without code, memory, syscall or register substitution.
acceptance_cases.reject_or_incomplete: Instruction patch, forged register state, syscall substitution, unexplained detach/resume or trusted producer verdict replacing raw data.

acceptance_cases.positive: Bounded SIGKILL and tracing/adoption/reap drain account for every owned identity and prove no live subject remains.
acceptance_cases.reject_or_incomplete: Only L reaped, fixed-three-wait shortcut, leaked R/T, stale PGID signal, missing terminal identity, or cleanup overwrites the primary failure.

acceptance_cases.positive: A separate data-only checker reconstructs sources, request, raw events, all relations, counts and cleanup without executing subject bytes.
acceptance_cases.reject_or_incomplete: Missing/duplicate/reordered events, truncated streams, wrong occurrence joins, mutable input, or producer/hosted-summary-only acceptance.

acceptance_cases.positive: Every timeout, interruption, budget breach or unsupported event is preserved as incomplete with its exact primary failure.
acceptance_cases.reject_or_incomplete: Skipped or warning-only qualification treated as success, retry appended to same attempt, or omitted failure prefix.

acceptance_cases.positive: A completed future record reports only observed containment-entry relations within declared observer/kernel trust.
acceptance_cases.reject_or_incomplete: Physical authenticity, kernel filter readback, shim/Python/operator execution, B2 completion, metric pass or release authority inferred from an intermediate success.

launch.arguments_encoding: ASCII tokens, each terminated by exactly one NUL

initial_helper_FD_roles.3: sealed NUL-separated arguments; survives initial launcher exec
initial_helper_FD_roles.4: sealed static entry bytes; survives initial launcher exec
initial_helper_FD_roles.5: sealed selected containment BPF; survives initial launcher exec
initial_helper_FD_roles.6: sealed original launcher ELF; CLOEXEC; initial execveat AT_EMPTY_PATH target
initial_helper_FD_roles.7: owned helper barrier; CLOEXEC; no input-controlled commands

launch.mount_requirement: Private read-only root tmpfs and read-only bind of copied entry; exact per-mount VFS flags and pinned root walk.

next_terminal_boundary.rip_requirement: Exact admitted static ELF e_entry after successful exec; no interpreter and no user instruction executed.

R_park.status_pointer: dynamic writable task memory bound at syscall entry

observation_contract.cleanup: At successful terminal collection all three roles are owned/stopped: pidfd_send_signal(SIGKILL,NULL,0) in T/R/L order, then globally drain nonblocking owned trace/adoption/reap notifications until no live owned identity remains; never block on R ahead of T or assume exactly three wait results.
observation_contract.explicit_stop_state_ledger: Never INTERRUPT an already stopped role; record every stop and restart.
observation_contract.final_removal: Consumed terminal statuses plus qualified final pidfd POLLHUP and drained owned wait state; POLLIN/zombie, WNOHANG=0 or ESRCH alone is insufficient.
fresh_L_checkpoints: initial launcher exec-stop binds launcher/interpreter identity
separate stopped syscall-entry checkpoint before first namespace clone binds complete selected-native mapping/backing roster
observation_contract.incomplete_prefix_cleanup: Signal and drain only identities actually created and owned, in reverse role order; do not wait for absent roles or require every survivor to reach its intended stop before SIGKILL. Missing final removal proof keeps the attempt incomplete.
observation_contract.initial_barrier: EOF, invalid token or observer loss fails closed. SEIZE alone is not a stop; consume INTERRUPT stop before release. No intermediate helper task or shell.
observation_contract.newborn_stop_join: Join parent event-message outer PID and newborn PTRACE_EVENT_STOP/SIGTRAP regardless of notification order; inherited options, no reattach.
observation_contract.observer_subreaper: Set and read back PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER before L; normal SIGCHLD disposition, no SA_NOCLDWAIT or competing wait consumer; restore prior state only after verified cleanup.
observation_contract.ptrace_strategy: PTRACE_SEIZE at owned barrier, PTRACE_INTERRUPT, then bounded PTRACE_SYSCALL; never detach
required_raw_evidence: final namespace handles and uid/gid maps
task-bound mountinfo and pinned root walk
exact file bytes/modes and descriptor roster
R and T sock_fprog and BPF submission bytes/returns
observation_contract.seccomp_claim: Exact selected-program submission and successful return, not privileged kernel filter readback or exhaustive future behavior.
observation_contract.unexpected_native_mapping: Reject before further subject execution; never extend the selected roster from observations.

proposed_budgets_not_observed_measuremen.event_stream_storage: Bounded sequential streams, not one filesystem member per event.
proposed_budgets_not_observed_measuremen.on_exceeded: Preserve incomplete attempt and primary failure, perform bounded owned cleanup; no automatic budget increase.

stages: new real runtime/operator selections and recoverable capsule
separately reviewed selected-loader exec-stop after shim execution

creation_contracts.child_tid_pointer: dynamic selected glibc TLS address; bind before syscall; do not prefill

task_graph.expected_ptrace_birth_event: PTRACE_EVENT_FORK for SIGCHLD clone calls; selected-host qualification required

subject_roles.meaning: Trusted preexec helper becomes original launcher monitor in the same task.
Namespace setup task becomes namespace PID 1 and reaper.
Payload task execs exact static entry and remains stopped.
